content.short: In a world riddled with dogs, lobsters, apes, penguins and llamas, Pudgy gives back the Cryptoverse to its lawful.
content.description: In the beginning, the Earth was without form and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep. Several million years later, the Earth became kingdom to a superior species of beings commonly referred as “Cats”, who ruled upon any land their paws could touch. When human beings started to move on a different digital domain called “The Internet”, cats swiftly imposed their dominance on that too, colonizing forums, chats, newsletters and social networks.
